review_text: Incredible machine. The M3 Max chews through 4K video editing without dropping a frame. Battery life is surprisingly good for this much power. Only downside is the high price, but it's worth it for professionals.
Excellent laptop for coding. Compiling large projects is blisteringly fast. I wish it had more ports, but the screen is beautiful.
The OLED screen is absolutely gorgeous. The RTX 4070 handles my 3D rendering tasks easily. It does get a bit warm under heavy load, but the performance is stellar.
The titanium build makes a huge difference; it's much lighter than my 14 Pro Max. The 5x camera is fantastic for concerts.
Best noise cancellation I've ever experienced. Great for flights. They don't fold up as small as the XM4s, which is a bit annoying for travel.
